points: Native HubSpot CRM integration — no middleware, zero sync lag
2× faster onboarding: avg 3 weeks vs. 7 weeks for Salesforce
All-in pricing — no per-seat add-ons for APIs or analytics
Live support SLA included at every tier
Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem is larger (5,000+ integrations)
Enterprise customization depth — complex workflow rules
Longer brand recognition in F500 procurement
"We're already on Salesforce" → Ask: what's your renewal date? Switching costs drop at contract end.
"Salesforce has more integrations" → 1,400+ HubSpot integrations cover 95% of SMB+mid-market stacks.
"Enterprise needs Salesforce" → Reference: Loom, Canva, and Postman all run HubSpot at scale.
